scope.issue_contract: Parent-supplied Issue45936 exact immutable Task state source extension; remote issue not retrieved because API calls were prohibited.

findings_P0_P1_P2.title: One Goal submission can freeze Task references from different backlog revisions
findings_P0_P1_P2.trigger: Submit at least two explicit task: references through Goal request_complete while a Task/backlog commit occurs between the per-reference reads.
findings_P0_P1_P2.source_evidence: capture sorts/deduplicates references and folds over them. Every Task_source calls capture_task, which independently calls Workspace.read_backlog_r. Goal request_current_proof holds a Goal transaction, not the backlog lease. Task normal submission holds its backlog lease, but the shared capture function is also a Goal consumer.
findings_P0_P1_P2.impact: The same immutable proof request can combine Task A from revisionN with Task B from revisionN+1. Each row is individually authentic and version-labelled, but the submission no longer represents one primary observation for an ordered/multiple-Task contract.
findings_P0_P1_P2.repair_direction: When the capture batch contains Task references, read the strict primary backlog once and pass that immutable value to every Task capture. Preserve strict primary failure and exact duplicate-ID refusal. Add a two-Task fixture asserting one shared revision/observation without broad locks or a second store.
findings_P0_P1_P2.validation_level: Independent source trace only; no concurrent runtime reproduction in this review. Parent separately received the same finding from design response and accepted repair.

findings_P0_P1_P2.title: Unconditional new Task lookup authority prevents resuming existing retained Task/Goal Originals
findings_P0_P1_P2.trigger: An existing pre-change Task/Goal retained Original in Captured or Admission_wait has no settled receipt, no explicit task: source, and is resumed after deploying this head.
findings_P0_P1_P2.source_evidence: Task_source is added to all_tools and every Workspace/Goal surface even when submitted_evidence contains no Task source. Complete schemas enter review binding digests. Existing Originals retain old lookup_schemas/binding. Goal matches_authority requires both to match exactly; Goal Worker rejects with Authority_changed before dispatch. Task Worker similarly requires exact binding/schema names and rejects with Grants_mismatch. The Goal agent reuses the current request retained frontier and maps the refusal to Proof_lookup_unavailable.
findings_P0_P1_P2.impact: The unrelated Task source extension changes authority for older requests and blocks safe resume even when they never requested this new capability. It must not be repaired by relaxing immutable-original identity validation.
findings_P0_P1_P2.repair_direction: Offer Task_source only when the immutable submitted_evidence actually contains an explicit captured Task source. Keep previous descriptor bytes/order/binding unchanged for Task-free surfaces; validate both Task and Goal retained Original consumers. Do not add a version/compatibility knob or weaken the authority guard.
findings_P0_P1_P2.validation_level: Independent exact-source control-flow/equality trace only; no native/model execution. Parent explicitly accepted this second P2 and least-authority repair.

positive_source_assessment.detail: capture_task filters the strict primary backlog by exact Task ID. Missing row is Source_unavailable, duplicate matching rows are Storage_failed, and read_backlog_r refuses recovered observations. The payload preserves backlog version/display timestamp plus Masc_domain.task_to_yojson of the canonical row. It is canonical typed state, not a byte-for-byte copy of the whole backlog file.

Capture serializes source bytes once and computes SHA256. Persistence decode rechecks reference form/content hash/object shape. submitted_source requires exactly one matching captured identity and never reads current backlog. read_task checks source kind/version/canonical Task identity. Referencing an uncaptured Task is Policy_rejection; corruption/mismatched identity is Runtime_failure.

The existing canonical keeper_tasks_list descriptor is reused with a narrowed object schema requiring exactly one task_ids item and permitting only the existing typed paging cursor. Dispatch validates against that same descriptor and executes read_task over retained bytes rather than the live Task-list handler. No broad backlog listing, new filesystem root or mutation tool is added.

New Task source reuses the existing SHA-bound exact JSON text paging with UTF-8 byte boundaries and bridge-size fitting. Authored large-source test reconstructs pages through actual Tool_bridge.to_agent_core_typed_result, checks contiguous bytes/digest/full Task JSON and rejects wrong-digest/invalid cursors. This fixture is authored and unexecuted in this scope.

Production Task submission partitions collaboration refs and captures before request commit through Verification_protocol, installed Workspace hooks and backlog-locked transition preparation. Goal request_complete captures through Workspace_goals before proof mark/Goal phase update. Native fixture invokes actual Task protocol persistence/load and public Goal dispatcher/get_record_authoritative, not a parallel source implementation.

No new Goal-link requirement, completion gate, approval counter, budget or automatic phase transition is introduced. Fixture explicitly uses a contractless Task. Prompts distinguish Done row state/time/notes from typed verifier/verification-ID certificate, whole approval history, edit ordering proof and external acceptance. Original Goal measurement and human confirmation remain separate.

New corruption/wrong identity/duplicate primary/recovered-primary and before/after-approval/edit/delete cases assert directly outside callback isolation; with_fixture uses Fun.protect cleanup rather than swallowing assertions. Pending and approved canonical state are compared, with persistence roundtrip and both authority types. Native execution remains unverified; the tests do not yet cover the two P2 boundaries.
